newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Second powerful quake rocks Bogota, Colombia.
newsitem.headline: Second powerful quake rocks Bogota, Colombia.

text.p: A powerful earthquake measuring 6.2 on the Richter scale shook large areas of Colombia, including the capital Bogota, on Wednesday afternoon, a spokesman for the National Seismological Institute said.
The tremor struck at 2:13 p.m.local time (1913 GMT) and was felt across most of the country, violently shaking high buildings in Bogota. There were no immediate reports of damage or injury.

The quake was centred close to the epicentre of another tremor, measuring 6 on the Richer scale, that jolted northeast Colombia at 2:07 a.m. on Wednesday, the spokesman said. Both were centred in a mountainous area about 25 miles (40 km) southeast of Bucaramanga, the capital of northern Santander province.

The spokesman said the quakes were powerful enough to cause severe damage in a populated area but the potential for destruction was limited by the fact that both occurred nearly 100 miles (160 km) below the surface.
